content:
Not with any precise guarantee.

I can have a rough expectation (e.g., “this will probably be a short paragraph” vs. “this will likely be a long, multi-section answer”) based on:

- How complex your question is  
- Whether you explicitly asked for brevity or detail  
- Formatting constraints (e.g., “limit to 200 words,” “in 3 bullet points,” etc.)

But I don’t “plan” an exact word count or token count ahead of time in a way I can reliably report before composing the answer. My generation process is step‑by‑step: I select each next token based on what’s been written so far and the instructions, not from a pre-written block whose size I know in advance.

If you need a specific size (e.g., “about 150 words,” “under 10 sentences,” “no more than one screen of text”), I can aim for that and usually get close, but it’s still approximate rather than exact.
